programme.title: Bobby and Giada in Italy
programme.desc: While Rome is a city steeped in tradition, the food scene is being updated with modern techniques and new flavor combinations. From pizza pies inspired by famous pastas to a trendy food market, Bobby Flay and Giada De Laurentiis explore how the food culture is evolving while still honoring the classics. Plus, they cook up some cutting-edge cuisine with a local Michelin star chef.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond puts together a quick and easy ranch-style cookout. She makes super-fast Caribbean Burgers with Mango Slaw for a taste of the islands in Oklahoma, and her Sunshine Pasta Salad and Lemon Mustard Dressing is a colorful side dish. Ree takes a shortcut for her a showstopping Rustic Strawberry Tart with sweetened whipped cream, and her cheesy Million Dollar Dip rounds out the speedy spread.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: The Beat Bobby Flay tournament finale brings four winners back for a chance to defeat a Food Network legend and score $50,000. In round one, appetizers are to be created using stuffed doughnuts, pig kidneys, upland cress, and dried mangosteen. Two of the chefs will be eliminated after the entrée round which features ingredients such as tilefish, lacy cauliflower, potted meat, and rhubarb liqueur. The final chef will go head-to-head with Chef Bobby Flay.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.desc: On a road trip to a special campground, host Jesse Palmer needs to make a pit stop for the perfect road snack -- a chocolate bar -- which inspires the bakers to craft road trip portable desserts. As Jesse settles into his over-the-top "glampsite," he challenges bakers to create glam summer cobbler desserts before glamorous judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Damaris Phillips decide who takes a hike.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Everyone is busy with the wheat harvest on the farm, so Molly Yeh is making a meal to share with the farmers and keep them fueled and happy for the days ahead. They love her cheesy Ham, Spinach and Potato Pizzas -- with wheat crust, of course! Molly also makes Creamy Navy Bean and Rosemary Dip and a tangy Tomato Green Bean Salad with Wheat Berries, and for dessert, she whips up Coconut Pudding with Roasted Rhubarb.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

The appetizer round includes peanut butter and jelly hot dogs, peanuts, steak bites, and poblano peppers. The entrée round features giant peanut butter cup, jelly packets, chicken thighs, and bok choy. Peanut butter and jelly ice cream sandwiches, basil, raisins on the vine, and PB&J moonshine are basket ingredients in the dessert round.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Chopped Castaways
programme.desc: The remaining six chefs wade into the lagoon to secure their protein. In a fiery Gauntlet showdown, the bottom two chefs face a prickly crustacean.

programme.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programme.desc: The returning champ takes on formidable chefs Leo Davila and Demetrio Zavala in the "eggs-treme" challenge of conquering the competition.

programme.title: Dinner: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine goes to Catalina Island off the coast of Southern California for a mission in paradise. After 2020 put a damper on the small island's tourism season, Robert is called to ring in the new season and celebrate the island getting back on its feet. He needs to make a celebratory meal for 75 locals, but every dish must be handheld and include either bison or seafood -- two of the island's most revered ingredients. After building his own kitchen and braving the open ocean in a kayak, Robert gets pulled in one more direction: He must help a local restaurant open with a bang, Restaurant: Impossible-style. With everything on his plate, Robert struggles to finish this dinner in time and not let down the locals.

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship
programme.desc: Host Jesse Palmer is cruising through the American Southwest in a convertible enjoying the desert vistas and local cuisine when he gets the idea for dessert tacos. He tasks the bakers with crafting sweet tacos that are perfect bites of handheld deliciousness. Then, he takes the bakers on a trip to Sedona, where they make tres leches cakes celebrating local attractions like energy vortexes, desert sunsets and hot air ballooning. Feeling the desert vibes, judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Damaris Phillips bring the dry heat when they decide which baker must make journey home.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is geared up for an action-packed morning of ranching and get-ahead cooking. She stocks the freezer with a marvelous Meatball and Polenta Casserole, awesome Everything Bagel Bombs with Everything Bagel Seasoning and a twist on a classic that's good enough for company, Hasselback Chicken Cordon Bleu with Simple Sauteed Green Beans. Then she wraps up a busy day with meaty, hearty Ham and Collard Soup for dinner.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: Selena Gomez and Raquelle meet up with Chef Marcel Vigneron at his Hollywood hotspot, Lemon Grove. Marcel greets Selena with three of his favorite dishes that set the bar for how good her dish will need to be to make the menu! While Raquelle discovers the delights of the professional walk-in refrigerator, Selena creates a colorful dish using some very unusual ingredients. The ultimate decision is down to Marcel and his team on whether her purple plate will be their new special or just a color bomb.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Bobby and Giada in Italy
programme.desc: For their final week in Italy, Bobby Flay and Giada De Laurentiis are in wine country! It's a chef's dream as they source high-end local ingredients and visit an iconic winery in Montalcino, a medieval fortress town set in the Tuscan hills and made famous for its Brunello wine. Bobby and Giada suit up to learn the art of beekeeping and what goes into making the famous honey. Then, the ingredients they find are the makings of an epic meal overlooking the Tuscan countryside -- one they will never forget!

programme.title: Kodachrome
programme.desc: Mets jau desmit gadus nav kontaktējies ar savu tēvu. Taču, negaidīti uzzinot, ka tēvs ir nāvējoši slims, Mets ir gatavs izpildīt viņa pēdējo vēlēšanos – aizvest attīstīt četras "Kodachrome" foto filmiņas, kuras glabā tēvam dārgas atmiņas. Kopā ar tēvu un viņa palīdzi Mets dodas braucienā uz vienīgo palikušo "Kodak" laboratoriju, lai pirms tās slēgšanas paspētu attīstīt šīs filmiņas.

programme.title: Londonas krišana
programme.desc: Noslēpumainos apstākļos mirst Lielbritānijas premjerministrs, un visiem rietumvalstu līderiem ir jāierodas uz viņa bērēm. Šis pasaulē visstingrāk apsargātais pasākums pārvēršas nāvējošā sazvērestībā ar mērķi noslepkavot pasaules ietekmīgākos līderus un ļaut piepildīties šausmīgai nākotnes vīzijai. Vienīgie, kuriem varētu būt kaut mazākā iespēja to nepieļaut, ir ASV prezidents, ASV slepenā dienesta vadītājs, kurš cilvēkos iedveš bijību, un kāds angļu MI-6 dienesta aģents, kurš neuzticas pilnīgi nevienam.

programme.title: Ķēķis
programme.desc: Pusdienu steigas laikā Manhatanas restorānā "The Grill" no kases ir pazudusi nauda. Visi virtuvē strādājošie pavāri bez dokumentiem tiek pratināti, un lielākās aizdomas krīt uz Pedro. Viņš ir sapņotājs, kas allaž pamanās iekulties nepatikšanās, un ir iemīlējies Džūlijā, amerikāņu viesmīlē, kura nevēlas ielaisties nopietnās attiecībās ar viņu. Restorāna īpašnieks Rašīds ir solījis Pedro palīdzēt sakārtot dokumentus, lai viņš varētu kļūt par "legālu" darbinieku. Taču šokējošs atklājums par Džūliju pamudina Pedro uz rīcību, kas uz visiem laikiem var apturēt darbību vienā no pilsētas noslogotākajām virtuvēm.

programme.title: Slepkavu karalis
programme.desc: Garans ir augsta ranga pasūtījuma slepkava, taču, kopš viņš zaudēja savas dzīves lielo mīlestību, viņa prātu nodarbina vienīgi rūpes par slimo meitu un alkas atriebties. Kamēr viņš cenšas sagrabināt naudu smagi slimās meitas ārstēšanai, viņu apciemo noslēpumains vīrs ar vilinošu piedāvājumu - kopā ar citiem pasaules bīstamākajiem slepkavām piedalīties asiņainās medībās. Mērķis - slepkavu karalis Jorgs Drakošs, atlīdzība - 10 miljoni dolāru. Garans piekrīt iesaistīties šajās nāvējošajās sacīkstēs, taču drīz vien saprot, ka no mednieka ir kļuvis par medījumu.

programme.title: Smurfi
programme.desc: Laipni lūdzam smurfu pasaulē! Burvis Gargamels ir piespiedis smurfus bēgt no dzimtā ciema. Ģimenes komēdija, kurā animācijas filmas varoņi parādās spēlfilmā.

programme.title: Dusmīgie putni. Filma
programme.desc: Reiz uz kādas paradīzes salas dzīvoja putni, kas nemācēja lidot. Tāpēc viņi visi bija labi, miermīlīgi un laimīgi... Precīzāk, gandrīz visi. Uz pārējo salas iemītnieku fona depresīvais Reds, trauksmainais Čaks un neveiklais Bumba izcēlās ar savu neparedzamo uzvedību un skaitījās izstumtie. Taču, kad salā pēkšņi parādījās noslēpumainās zaļās cūkas, kam noteikti aiz ādas bija kāda cūcība, tieši Reds, Čaks un Bumba stājās viņiem pretī!

programme.title: Arī divi ir ģimene
programme.desc: Bezrūpīgā brunču mednieka Semjuela dzīvē viss ir vienkārši un viegli, taču kādā jaukā dienā ar mazuli uz rokām uzrodas viena no viņa neskaitāmajām draudzenēm Kristīna. Paziņojusi, ka tā ir viņa meita, Kristīna aizlido uz Londonu, atstājot Semu vienu ar bērniņu. Pēkšņi par tēvu kļuvušais Sems, vēl neatguvies no šoka, kopā ar mazulīti lido uz Angliju cerībā uzmeklēt meitenītes māti. Tā kā meklējumi ir nesekmīgi, Semam atliek vien samierināties ar jauno tēva lomu un vienam audzināt meitu. Taču pēc astoņiem gadiem meitenītes māte tomēr uzrodas….

programme.title: Smurfi: Zudušais ciemats
programme.desc: Jaunajā, pilnībā animētajā "Smurfu" sērijā mūsu varoņi atrod noslēpumainu karti un dodas briesmu pilnajā piedzīvojumā, lai meklētu zudušo ciematu. Ceļš smurfus vedīs cauri noslēpumainam mežam, kur dzīvo maģiskas būtnes, bet viņiem pa pēdām sekos ļaunais burvis Gargamelis. Smurfi pat nenojauš, ka, izejot cauri visiem pārbaudījumiem, viņi atklās smurfu lielāko noslēpumu.

programme.title: Trusītis Pēterītis
programme.desc: Ir mierpilna diena vienā no skaistākajām Anglijas vietām. Putniņi mīlīgi čivina, strautiņš urdz, un saule apmirdz zaļos pakalnus. Te pēkšņi cauri zālājam aizšaujas pūkains kamoliņš. Tas ir trusītis Pēterītis, un viņš dodas ļoti svarīgā misijā. Kopā ar trim māsiņām trusītis Pēterītis spriņģo taisnā ceļā uz Makgregora kunga mazdārziņa pusi. Tur izaudzēti labu labie dārzeņi, kas tā vien prasās tik apēsti. Taču reiz namā uz dzīvi apmetas Makgregora kunga radinieks, kurš par nelūgtajiem dārza labumu čiepējiem nemaz nav sajūsmā. Tā sākas nikni ķīviņi, jautri piedzīvojumi un daudz nepatikšanu, kurās trusītis Pēterītis kopā ar draugiem pamanīsies iekulties.

programme.title: Dusmīgie putni. Filma
programme.desc: Nelidojošie dusmīgie putni joprojām karo ar viltīgajām zaļajām cūkām. Viņi ir ļaunākie ienaidnieki, un, šķiet, nekas nespēs to mainīt. Taču, kad pie apvāršņa parādās jaunas briesmas, kas apdraud viņus visus, putniem un cūkām nāksies apvienoties, lai glābtu savas mājas.

programme.title: Rio
programme.desc: Animācijas filmas "Ledus laikmets" veidotāji sagatavojuši jaunu piedzīvojumu komēdiju visai ģimenei. Blū ir pieradināts papagailis, kas tā arī nav iemācījies lidot. Viņš visu mūžu baudījis ērtības Minesotas štata mazpilsētā, kur dzīvo kopā ar savu saimnieci Lindu. Blū un Linda ir pārliecināti, ka viņš ir pēdējais savas sugas pārstāvis, taču, kad izrādās, ka Riodežaneiro dzīvo arī krāšņā Džuela, abi dodas uz turieni, lai viņu uzmeklētu. Jau drīz vien pēc ierašanās Blū un Džuelu nolaupa eksotisko dzīvnieku tirgotāji. Taču Džuela ir radusi pie dzīves pilsētas ielās, un ar vairāku runājošu putnu palīdzību viņiem izdodas tikt brīvībā. Draugu un Džuelas iedrošināts, Blū beidzot iemācīsies lidot, lai varētu atgriezties pie savas labākās draudzenes Lindas.

programme.title: Snūpijs un Čārlijs Brauns: Riekstiņu filma
programme.desc: Čarlijs Brauns, Snūpijs un visi pārējie atgriežas ar šo aizkustinošo stāstu. Kad apkārtnē uz dzīvi apmetas jauna sarkanmataina meitene, Čārlijs Brauns viņā iemīlas. Viņš vairākkārt mēģina pievērst jaunās meitenes uzmanību un dažādos veidos mēģina savā dzīvē kaut ko sasniegt, taču katru reizi šķiet, ka neveicas arvien vairāk. Vai viņam izdosies iepatikties savai mīlestībai? Tajā pašā laikā Snūpijs apņemas tikt galā ar savu ļaunāko ienaidnieku - Sarkano Baronu.

programme.title: Pērtiķis
programme.desc: Filmas pamatā ir Stīvena Kinga stāsts. Kad dvīņubrāļi Hals un Bils tēva bēniņos atrod tēva antīko rotaļlietu pērtiķa veidolā, viņiem apkārt sāk notikt šausminoši nāves gadījumi. Lai izvairītos no lāsta, brāļi atbrīvojas no pērtiķa un dodas katrs savu ceļu. Taču, kad cilvēki atkal sāk mirt neizskaidrojamos apstākļos, brāļi panāk izlīgumu un dodas uzdevumā, lai pilnībā iznīcinātu nolādēto rotaļlietu.

programme.title: Kandahāra
programme.desc: Misija ir izgāzusies, un CIP darbinieka Toma Herisa (Džerards Batlers) identitāte ir atklāta. Viņu vajā pasaules labākie algotņi un ienaidnieka elites speciālie spēki. Tomam ir 30 stundas, lai šķērsotu tuksnesi un nokļūtu Kandahārā - tā ir vienīgā cerība uz izglābšanos.

programme.title: Sašķeltais
programme.desc: Dziļi Kevina sadrumstalotās, apdāvinātās apziņas nostūros mīt divdesmit trīs atšķirīgas personības, bet viņa psihiatre uzskata, ka vēl viena personība joprojām ir apslēpta un tā parādīsies, kļūstot par dominējošo. Ļaunprātīgais un izmanīgais Keisijs liek Kevinam nolaupīt trīs pusaudzes, un Kevinā sākas cīņa par izdzīvošanu starp visām viņā mītošajām personībām, tāpat kā cīņa par izdzīvošanu sākas arī ārpus viņa, jo sāk brukt personības atdalošās sienas.

programme.title: Bostonas slepkava
programme.desc: 60. gados Bostonu pārbiedē virkne nežēlīgu slepkavību, kuru upuri ir sievietes. Spītējot tā laika uzskatam par sieviešu lomu sabiedrībā un viedokli, ka daiļā dzimuma pārstāvēm jāraksta par modi un izklaidi, nevis jāšķetina nopietni noziegumi, Loreta un viņas kolēģe Džīna Koula atklāj, ka Bostonā notikušās sieviešu nožņaugšanas ir savstarpēji saistītas un tās paveicis sērijveida slepkava. Loreta slepkavu nodēvē par "Bostonas žņaudzēju", četru rakstu sērijā atklājot satraucošas likumsakarības un iestāžu kļūdas, kas ļāva slepkavam nekontrolēti darboties.

programme.title: Smurfi: Zudušais ciemats
programme.desc: Jaunajā, pilnībā animētajā "Smurfu" sērijā mūsu varoņi atrod noslēpumainu karti un dodas briesmu pilnajā piedzīvojumā, lai meklētu zudušo ciematu. Smurfi pat nenojauš, ka, izejot cauri visiem pārbaudījumiem, viņi atklās smurfu lielāko noslēpumu.

programme.title: Viesnīca Transilvānija
programme.desc: Laipni lūgti viesnīcā "Transilvānija", Drakulas krāšņajā pieczobu kūrortā, kurā monstri var izbaudīt nesteidzīgu atpūtu. Ir pienākusi īpaša nedēļas nogale, kuras laikā Drakula ir ielūdzis ciemos dažus no saviem labākajiem draugiem. Ir plānots svinēt Drakulas meitas Meivisas pilngadību – 118. dzimšanas dienu. Uzņemt tik kuplu viesu pulku Drakulas ģimenei nav problēma. Tomēr jukas izceļas, kad viesnīcā ieklīst parasts puisis un ieskatās viņa meitā.

programme.title: Jēzus atmoda
programme.desc: Iedvesmojoša biogrāfiska drāma par ticības, cerības un garīgas atmodas spēku laikā, kad sabiedrībā valda nemiers un sašķeltība. Filmas darbība risinās 20. gadsimta 70. gadu sākumā Amerikā, kur jauna paaudze, nogurusi no tradicionālajām vērtībām un dzīves tukšuma, meklē patiesību, mīlestību un piederību. Stāsta centrā ir neparasta draudzība starp konservatīvu mācītāju un harismātisku jauniešu līderi, kuri, pārvarot aizspriedumus un atšķirīgos uzskatus, kļūst par daļu no garīgas kustības, kas maina daudzu cilvēku dzīves. Caur personīgiem pārdzīvojumiem, konfliktiem un piedošanas tēmu filma atklāj, kā ticība spēj vienot cilvēkus un dot jaunu sākumu.

programme.title: Līdz uzvaras vārtiem
programme.desc: Bez darba palikušais un alkoholu mīlošais futbola treneris Tomass Rongens dodas uz Amerikāņu Samoa, lai vadītu izlasi un palīdzētu tai sagatavoties pasaules čempionāta atlases sacensībām. Galvenā problēma valstsvienības pastāvēšanas vēsturē ir tāda, ka komanda vēl ne reizi nav iesitusi nevienus vārtus un spēles laikā ir uzstādījusi antirekordu futbola vēsturē - 31 reizi vienas spēles laikā bumba ielaista viņu vārtos. Tomasu sagaida grūts darbs ne tikai ar komandu, bet arī pašam ar sevi.

programme.title: Spoku mednieki: Sasaluma impērija
programme.desc: Spengleru ģimene atgriežas vietā, kur viss sākās – ikoniskajā Ņujorkas ugunsdzēsēju depo –, lai apvienotos ar sākotnējiem Spoku medniekiem, kuri izveidojuši īpaši slepenu izpētes laboratoriju, paceļot spoku medīšanu nākamajā līmenī. Bet, kad sena artefakta atklāšana atbrīvo ļaunu spēku, jaunajiem un vecajiem Spoku medniekiem jākļūst par vienu komandu, lai aizstāvētu savu pilsētu un glābtu pasauli no jauna ledus laikmeta.

programme.title: Madagaskara
programme.desc: Iemīļotie animācijas filmas "Madagaskara" varoņi ir atgriezušies! Pingvīni, liekot lietā teju vai militāru precizitāti un visus iespējamos līdzekļus, ir saremontējuši vecu, reiz avarējušu lidmašīnu. Iecerēts, ka tieši tajā pazīstamie Madagaskaras varoņi dosies atpakaļ uz mājām - uz Ņujorku. Plāns ir labs, taču drīz vien Alekss, Mārtijs, Melmans, Glorija un pingvīnu komanda strauji piezemējas mežonīgajos Āfrikas plašumos, kur zoodārzā augusī četrotne pirmoreiz satiek savus sugas brāļus. Kāds no viņiem šeit atradīs savus radus, citam būs romantiski piedzīvojumi, bet nav gan zināms, vai Āfrika būs labāka par viņu mājām Centrālparka zoodārzā...

programme.title: Krūdi
programme.desc: Aizvēsturiska piedzīvojumu komēdija par pasaules pirmo ģimeni, kura dodas unikālā ceļojumā, kad viņu dzimtā ala tiek iznīcināta. Ceļojot pa elpu aizraujošajām ainavām, Krūdi atklāj pasakainu, jaunu vietu, kur mīt vēl neredzētas būtnes. Viņu pasaules uztvere mainās uz visiem laikiem.

programme.title: Zudušajās zemēs
programme.desc: Karaliene sūta vareno un bīstamo burvi Greju Alisu uz rēgainajiem Zudušo Zemes mežonīgajiem plašumiem meklēt maģisku spēku, kur burvei un viņas pavadonim, klejotājam Boisam, jāapspēlē un jāpārspēj gan cilvēki, gan dēmoni.

programme.title: Killera sievas miesassargs
programme.desc: Miesassargs Maikls Braiss beidzot var atviegloti uzelpot. Trakais killers Dariuss Kinkeids, kurš piebeidzis veselu baru ļaužu visā pasaulē, nu ir nozudis. Saule, mīļākā grāmata un ne domas par Kinkeidu – ko gan vēl varētu vēlēties, lai atgūtu formu. Taču tad pludmalē uzrodas līdz matu galiem apbruņotā Kinkeida sieva Sonja, un viņai ir sliktas ziņas – Kinkeids ir Itālijā, viņu nolaupījuši teroristi un tie ir jāiznīcina!

programme.title: Draiskule
programme.desc: Kopš bērnības Eimijas brunčumednieks tēvs ir pārliecinājis viņu, ka monogāmija nav iespējama. Tagad Eimija strādā žurnāla redakcijā un dzīvo ar šādu pārliecību, baudot dzīvi, kas ir brīva no smacējošām, garlaicīgām romantiskajām saistībām, tomēr patiesībā viņa ir iegrimusi rutīnā. Reiz Eimija secina, ka sāk iemīlēties sava jaunā raksta varonī – apburošajā un veiksmīgajā sporta ārstā Āronā Konersā. Tas liek sievietei prātot, vai citi pieaugušie, tostarp šis puisis, kuram ir patiesas simpātijas pret Eimiju, varētu pārliecināt viņu mainīt dzīves filozofiju.

programme.title: Eņģeļa krišana
programme.desc: Maiks Benings pilnībā nododas valsts dienestam, viņa galvenais uzdevums – gādāt par ASV prezidenta drošību. Kolēģi, ar kuriem Benings daudzus gadus strādājis plecu pie pleca, viņam neuzticas, tur viņu aizdomās par nodomu nonāvēt valsts galvu. Lai glābtu ne vien savu godu, bet arī dzīvību, Benings ir spiests slēpties un noskaidrot, kas un kāpēc vilina viņu un prezidentu slazdā.

programme.title: LaLiga. Valencia - Real Betis
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: UFC. Anthony Hernandez-Gregory Rodrigues
programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

Narrated by John Beach, this show follows a number of couples, families and people looking just for themselves exploring various beachfront's in USA, looking for homes that won't break the bank. Ensuring each person gets what they want, they are introduced to a number of properties that meet their ultimate dream home in the hopes that they will indeed find the one. With 101 episodes, Beachfront Bargain Hunt introduces you to the life that can be led, without breaking to bank, to live a life by the sea!

programme.title: Bahamas Life
programme.desc: The idyllic Bahamas are the perfect getaway for travellers and vacationers alike, but for some, once you visit the paradisaical islands, it's hard to forget their beauty. These enamored individuals drop their city lives for these stunning Caribbean shores, leaving their livelihoods, stresses and struggles behind. In each episode of Bahamas Life, we detail the processes involved, the choice of islands and the remarkable real estate opportunities for prospective buyers looking to fulfill their dreams.

programme.title: Bargain Block
programme.desc: Bargain Block follows home renovation experts and partners Keith Bynum and Evan Thomas on their journey to restore Detroit's iconic American neighborhoods one house at a time. With sound advice and support from their friend—lifetime Detroit resident and real estate expert Shea Hicks-Whitfield, who is expecting her first child—Keith and Evan buy multiple rundown and abandoned houses on a single block, take them down to the studs, and create affordable, stylish and fully furnished starter homes that are ideal for first-time homebuyers. Now settled in the Motor City, the couple, who have renovated and purchased their own home and opened a new retail store and workshop, infuse every property with a functional layout, artful design and beautiful repurposed furniture. The end result is incredible transformations of dilapidated homes that are an inspiration to the entire neighborhood.

programme.title: Cheap Old Houses
programme.desc: Cheap Old Houses is inspired by Ethan and Elizabeth Finkelstein's uber popular Instagram feed by the same name, which racks up millions of views with images of surprising property bargains that are architecturally intact and available for under $150,000. In each episode, cameras will follow the couple as they tour low-priced older houses across America and ultimately choose which ones to feature on their famous site.

programme.title: What's Wrong With That House?
programme.desc: Longtime New Jersey homeowners are tired of using shims to keep their furniture in place. Joe Mazza investigates the source of the home's slope while designer Noel Gatts restructures the main living spaces to make them more functional and fabulous.

programme.title: Down Home Fab
programme.desc: The DeBoers go on a spiritual design journey when they're hired to finish a home and turn it into a warm, healing space. Chelsea takes a deep dive into her love for plants as she designs the ultimate meditation room.

programme.title: Island Life
programme.desc: Pablo and Michelle are a newly engaged couple with a romantic story. On their first date Pablo took Michelle on a romantic helicopter ride around Los Angeles and it was love at first flight! The couple now resides in vibrant town of Homestead, FL, near South Beach. Although Pablo has enjoyed the Keys since he was a child, they became even more special to him with Michelle in his life. The Keys are a part of their love story. What started as a yearly romantic getaway blossomed into island visits that they'd plan as much as possible.

programme.title: Island Life
programme.desc: Most people only fantasize about living on an island, but we'll prove that an Island Life is possible for anyone. Tropical dreamers will be shown island properties that fit into any budget, from ultra-affordable to totally outrageous. We'll follow everyday families is search of their own slice of paradise, and prove that fantasy can be reality.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programme.desc: Recent lottery winners look for their perfect dream house in this "House Hunters"-inspired reality show. David Bromstad takes recent lottery winners on over-the-top house hunts for their new dream homes. Whether they win hundreds of thousands or hundreds of millions, lucky lottery winners everywhere are jumping headfirst into the real estate market. Will they spend all their winnings on an extravagant mansion or settle for a humble sound investment? Find out what happens when average Americans set out to find "My Lottery Dream Home".

programme.title: House Hunters
programme.desc: American reality series following host Suzanne Whang on her quest to help people relocate in search of their dream home. Follow the individuals, couples and families in an international search for their perfect property, exploring a stunning selection of homes chosen just for them. With three potential candidates to choose from, join them as they try and make the difficult decision to start a new life abroad. Revisit the new homeowners at the end of each episode to see how their properties have developed and how life has changed for them since the move.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: On March 19th, 2002, Gary McKinnon was arrested for hacking into 97 Pentagon and NASA computers over a 13-month period, in what authorities call the "biggest military computer hack of all time." McKinnon claimed that he found evidence of a secret American space fleet, by way of a list of dozens of "non-terrestrial officers" and their assigned spacecraft, replete with USSS (United States Space Ship) monikers. Might the United States military really have a secret space program? And if so, are we preparing for a space-based war with other nations... or other species? Ancient Astronaut theorists suggest that there are numerous factions of alien races with competing agendas visiting Earth, and that there is evidence they have been in conflict with each other for thousands of years. According to these theorists, there is evidence that these wars actually took place here on Earth in the distant past--not between gods, but between extraterrestrial visitors.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island: Drilling Down
programme.desc: A sister show to The Curse of Oak Island, "Drilling Down" is an American reality series that dives into the truths and myths that surround Oak Island, the rumoured treasure location scoured by the Lagina brothers in the original series. Featuring interviews with a variety of knowledgeable guests, Drilling Down offers a unique perspective on the stories that shroud Oak Island in mystery. This mysterious island has stumped treasure-seekers over the last few centuries, with many folk sure it holds an abundance of lost loot. The Lagina brothers have bought the rights to the majority of the island's land and, in the original series, they seek to be the first to locate its hidden treasures.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Pawn Stars Do America
programme.desc: For the first time, the "Pawn Stars" are hitting the road to visit some of America's most exciting places in search of historical finds and impressive collectible objects in the new 8-part series "Pawn Stars Do America." Each two-hour episode follows Rick Harrison, Corey Harrison and Austin "Chumlee" Russell as they step out of the World Famous Gold & Silver Pawn Shop in Las Vegas to connect with fans in eight different cities and acquire some of the most remarkable items imaginable.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: Beyond Oak Island
programme.desc: From the producers of "The Curse of Oak Island" and "The UnXplained" comes an exciting new documentary series, "Beyond Oak Island." Hosted by real-life treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, this eight episode series chronicles the greatest treasure hunts of the past, present and (perhaps) future. "Beyond Oak Island" offers a combination of great story telling, compelling interviews with treasure-hunters, historians and experts, as well as on-location treasure hunts in progress, sometimes with the Laginas themselves. From pirates such as Blackbeard and outlaws like Jesse James, to Aztec gold, priceless historical artifacts from American history and sunken treasure ships, "Beyond Oak Island" digs deep into the many treasure quests across the globe, revealing amazing new details and clues from past searches - and in some cases, advancing the hunt.

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: The list of military eyewitnesses describing strange and threatening unidentified craft in U.S airspace is growing. And now, a U.S. Navy radar operator has provided something more: Actual coordinates where UFOS appeared and disappeared. Lue Elizondo and a new partner follow the trail, and find that these unidentified craft are still seen. New eyewitnesses provide chilling details, and a correlation to U.S military sightings. As the reports mount, Lue closes in on a location where visitors are not allowed: Ground zero for the sightings.

programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: From conquering the depths of the oceans to defending the freedoms of the seas--ancient man pushed the technological boundaries to the limits in the mega battle for the oceans. New discoveries will reveal how an ancient destroyer rammed its way to victory in one of the most significant battles in human history. In Denmark, a team of divers build and test the world's first ever deep sea diving suit that was designed 350 years before the history books tell us it was possible to walk along the seabed. Can CSI science unravel the mystery of a time traveling ghost ship? And in a groundbreaking sea cannon experiment, naval experts will discover how a 16th century war fleet blasted their way to victory against an enemy armada seven miles wide, without the loss of a single ship.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: In 1975, Travis Walton claims to have been abducted and taken aboard a space ship inhabited by extraterrestrial beings. Several people witnessed his encounter and nearly 40 years later Walton's story of alien abduction, missing time and mind-telepathy manipulation has not wavered. But researchers say that abductions are not a modern phenomenon. The Hebrew Bible is filled with stories of abductions by otherworldly beings. Jonah, Moses, Ezekiel and Enoch all depict what can best be described as physically being taken to other dimensions and then returned. Is it possible that extraterrestrial beings have been abducting humans for thousands of years and if so, might there be an alien agenda behind the phenomena?

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: In 1975, Travis Walton claims to have been abducted and taken aboard a space ship inhabited by extraterrestrial beings. Several people witnessed his encounter and nearly 40 years later Walton's story of alien abduction, missing time and mind-telepathy manipulation has not wavered. But researchers say that abductions are not a modern phenomenon. The Hebrew Bible is filled with stories of abductions by otherworldly beings. Jonah, Moses, Ezekiel and Enoch all depict what can best be described as physically being taken to other dimensions and then returned. Is it possible that extraterrestrial beings have been abducting humans for thousands of years and if so, might there be an alien agenda behind the phenomena?

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Beyond Oak Island
programme.desc: From the producers of "The Curse of Oak Island" and "The UnXplained" comes an exciting new documentary series, "Beyond Oak Island." Hosted by real-life treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, this eight episode series chronicles the greatest treasure hunts of the past, present and (perhaps) future. "Beyond Oak Island" offers a combination of great story telling, compelling interviews with treasure-hunters, historians and experts, as well as on-location treasure hunts in progress, sometimes with the Laginas themselves. From pirates such as Blackbeard and outlaws like Jesse James, to Aztec gold, priceless historical artifacts from American history and sunken treasure ships, "Beyond Oak Island" digs deep into the many treasure quests across the globe, revealing amazing new details and clues from past searches - and in some cases, advancing the hunt.

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: In December of 2017, The New York Times published a stunning front-page exposé about the Pentagon's mysterious UFO program, the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP). Featuring an interview with a former military intelligence official and Special Agent In-Charge, Luis Elizondo, who confirmed the existence of the hidden government program, the controversial story was the focus of worldwide attention. Previously run by Elizondo, AATIP was created to research and investigate Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) including numerous videos of reported encounters, three of which were released to a shocked public in 2017. Elizondo resigned after expressing to the government that these UAPs could pose a major threat to our national security and not enough was being done to deal with them or address our potential vulnerabilities. Now, as a part of HISTORY's groundbreaking new six-part, one-hour limited series UNIDENTIFIED: INSIDE AMERICA'S UFO INVESTIGATION, Elizondo is speaking out for the first time with Tom DeLonge, co-founder and President of To The Stars Academy of Arts & Science and Chris Mellon, former Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense and Intelligence, to expose a series of startling encounters and embark on fascinating new investigations that will urge the public to ask questions and look for answers. The series will reveal newly authenticated evidence and footage, interviews from eyewitnesses and former military personnel who have never spoken out before, and extensive breakthroughs in understanding the technology behind these unknown phenomena in our skies.

programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: Some of the strangest and deadliest weapons ever built were prototypes of the modern gun. programme.title: Evolve
programme.desc: Throughout the eons of its existence, the natural world has played host to this never-ending competition called life. Since the dawn of time, roughly 99 percent of all species have become extinct. In order to survive, all creatures, including man, must treat life as a battlefield and master the natural weapons and defenses that they have evolved: Tyrannosaurus Rex's 13-inch canines; the Gecko's velcro-like toe pads; the Bald Eagle's telescopic vision capable of spotting a hare a mile away. How did these attributes, each unique to the organism itself, appear? Certainly not arbitrarily. They evolved for a common reason - to give these animals a critical edge in inter-species warfare, and to ensure the survival of the individual's genes into the next generation. To evolve is to survive!

programme.title: Battles BC
programme.desc: In 327 BC, Greece goes head-to-head with India in Alexander the Great's final campaign. As Alexander leads his armies into India, he faces one of the most difficult tactical challenges any ground commander can confront--a forced river-crossing, a raging thunder storm and a vicious enemy. Alexander is able to deceive the Indian General Porus into believing that they would not attempt a crossing, instead he maneuvers his infantry across the river at night--catching the Indian Legions unaware. Victory is at hand thanks to this strategic brilliance.

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: An encounter in the American heartland indicates a disturbing twist to the UFO phenomenon. The team follows a trail of explosive evidence connecting UFOs to the most destructive weapons in human history. A former U.S Air Force Colonel discloses an encounter on Christmas Eve 1980 at a base hiding a secret stockpile of nuclear weapons, while where another former Air Force officer describes a UFO-related injury. Was the U.S. military planting UFO misinformation to distract attention from top secret test, or are they hiding an even more ominous threat?

programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: Travel to Egypt to discover the mysteries of the mummified crocodiles of Kom Ombo. We'll x-ray an ancient mummy that has held a secret for 2000 years, and reveal the lengths that people will go to to ritualize death. New discoveries at the site of the world famous terracotta army in China reveal incredible insights into the mind-state of the great first emperor of China and his people; and what they believed about death. In Britain, forensic scientists solve a year old murder using 15th century forensic science, as well as hundreds of mini-detectives--blowflies. And using virtual reality techniques doctors will now look inside the body of a victim during a live crucifixion to discover horrific new truths about the suffering on the cross.

We'll x-ray an ancient mummy that has held a secret for 2000 years, and reveal the lengths that people will go to to ritualize death. New discoveries at the site of the world famous terracotta army in China reveal incredible insights into the mind-state of the great first emperor of China and his people; and what they believed about death. In Britain, forensic scientists solve a year old murder using 15th century forensic science, as well as hundreds of mini-detectives--blowflies. programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Ancient Impossible

programme.title: The Killer Closer
programme.desc: In the shadow of the Hollywood sign on the outskirts of Los Angeles are the city's roughest neighborhoods. In the late 1990s, LAPD's Foothill Homicide Unit investigated hundreds of murders, but only Detective Lindy Gligorijevic was dubbed "the killer closer". Driven by the need to give her victims a voice, Detective Gligorijevic revisits her most shocking cases with the Foothill Homicide Unit in Investigation Discovery's all-new series, THE KILLER CLOSER. Detailing how she solved each crime, and revealing how she convinced the most cold-blooded killers to confess, Detective Gligorijevic knows she can't bring closure to someone who's lost a loved one to murder, but she'll stop at nothing to get them justice.

programme.title: Swamp Murders
programme.desc: Explore the true stories behind some of the most gruesome murder scenes discovered in America's vast deserted swamplands. Follow in the footsteps of the leading detectives on each case as they get to work retracing the steps of the suspects and their victims. With dramatic recreations and exclusive interviews, each episode delves deep into the murky waters that cloud their investigations in the hopes of discovering what really happened and finally delivering justice to the victims and their families.

programme.desc: Retired Pasco County Pastor and avid coin collector, Billy Shuler, was reported missing by his wife after he went out one morning to meet with a prospective client and never returned home. A search is immediately ordered, and detectives find Schuler's abandoned van in an industrial parking lot, wherein the van's GPS system leads to the body. But even though progress was being made, the case went cold. After a year, police find an unlikely connection between several bank robberies and Shuler's murder, leading to the final conclusion of the case.

programme.title: Still A Mystery
programme.desc: Just because a case is closed doesn't mean the truth has been revealed. Suicide or murder? Runaway or kidnapping? Accidental or premeditated? Each episode of STILL A MYSTERY re-examines a single crime case where unanswered questions still remain. Through original interviews with law enforcement, family members and private investigators, news footage and social media, STILL A MYSTERY dissects the evidence and presents new theories in a quest to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: A person suddenly and unexpectedly disappears; no trace, no clues, nothing but the lingering mystery they leave behind. According to the FBI's National Crime Information Center, there are now 110,484 active missing persons cases in the U.S., 53% are juveniles under the age of 18. Most of us have heard of the high-profile cases, such as Natalee Holloway, Stacey Peterson, and Chandra Levy. But have you ever heard of Mae Catherine Rocker, Alexis Peterson or Thomas Jay Kerr? Probably not. They are just a few of the hundreds of thousands of people in this country who one day, simply Disappeared. Most missing person's stories have never been told...until now. Disappeared is an exciting series that investigates the disappearance of these victims, who are here one minute, gone the next. Each episode focuses on one victim's story, as told through the perspectives and actual voices of their closest friends and family and the investigators trying to solve the case. Through interviews with family, friends, police, and searchers, each episode recounts the actions, thoughts, circumstances and motivations that led to each person's disappearance. Experience the victim's final hours until they vanished. Watch interviews with experts, from psychologists to forensic specialists to psychics, who will offer new insights into what may have happened in each case, whether the person was a victim of foul play or a runaway. Disappeared will take you inside the world of the missing, where a person can vanish without a trace, investigators race against the clock to solve a mystery, and the victim's anguished family and friends are left to wonder what in the world could have happened.

programme.desc: Alina Burroughs investigates the evidence in some truly baffling murder cases ranging from a deadly fall from a balcony that turns out to be even more twisted than initially thought, to the case of the unexpected death of a young college student that was believed to be closed. From the unknown to the sensational, Burroughs uses her years of training to see the clues and uncover the mysteries that only an expert C.S.I. could catch, while also having emotional, and sometimes tense, conversations with both the victim's loved ones, and, at times, even the suspected or convicted perpetrator to understand more about the case.

programme.title: Murder Under the Friday Night Lights
programme.desc: True-crime programme that explores a number of shocking cases of dangerous obsessions, violence and even murder that are connected with high school football, and which occured in communities acros the USA where football is everything. Series uses archival footage and interviews with people connected to the crimes, to tell various hair-raising stories of cheerleaders gone missing, upcoming football stars who get gunned down, local authorities covering up for their best player, and more.

programme.title: Undercover Underage
programme.desc: Every day, countless adults utilize the internet with insidious intentions to groom, sexually exploit, and abuse children online. Committed to helping law enforcement stop these perpetrators, child advocate Roo Powell and the team at her nonprofit organization SOSA (Safe from Online Sex Abuse) work in collaboration with law enforcement to detect and identify the menacing adults who use the internet to harm children. Undercover Underage follows Roo as the 38-year-old mother of three transforms her appearance into a teen online. Once adults engage with Roo's underage decoys, it's a race against the clock to gather enough information to positively identify the offenders and get them on law enforcement's radar.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Michelle Kinney is a free-spirited, trusting and generous mother of two boys in the town of Dubuque, Iowa, who is loved by the entire town. When her battered and bloody body is discovered in her apartment, the community is left numb with shock. Investigators discover that Michelle often took in people who were going through tough times and needed a place to stay for a few nights. This leads them to question if her generous spirit contributed to her death. And what detectives unearth staggers citizens, friends and family alike.

programme.title: On the Case with Paula Zahn
programme.desc: Documentary series presented by the journalist Paula Zahn. Speaking to people connected with real-life crimes and looking at actions surrounding these shocking events, Zahn aims to uncover the truth behind true crime cases.

programme.title: The Killer Closer
programme.desc: In the shadow of the Hollywood sign on the outskirts of Los Angeles are the city's roughest neighborhoods. In the late 1990s, LAPD's Foothill Homicide Unit investigated hundreds of murders, but only Detective Lindy Gligorijevic was dubbed "the killer closer". Driven by the need to give her victims a voice, Detective Gligorijevic revisits her most shocking cases with the Foothill Homicide Unit in Investigation Discovery's all-new series, THE KILLER CLOSER. Detailing how she solved each crime, and revealing how she convinced the most cold-blooded killers to confess, Detective Gligorijevic knows she can't bring closure to someone who's lost a loved one to murder, but she'll stop at nothing to get them justice.

programme.title: 911: Did the Killer Call?
programme.desc: Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they're innocent, but one of them is the killer in disguise.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: In Albuquerque, NM, loving father and former firefighter Don Fluitt is found dead inside his home with no suspect in sight. Fluitt's body is found by coworkers who went to check on him when he didn't show up for work, and body camera footage captures the crucial moments after his remains are discovered. Investigators are left to figure out the motive behind his killing, working through a list of possible suspects, which include Don's family, landlord, and his ex-wife's new husband. Police make progress when they discover a chilling surveillance video that captures the killer on camera, but is it enough to solve this heinous crime?

programme.title: Crime Scene Confidential
programme.desc: CSI Alina Burroughs travels to rural Ohio to investigate the 1988 murder of Marjorie "Margie" Coffey, a single mother who was strangled and dumped in an icy creek. Alina discusses the forensic evidence used in the murder case, which centered upon two strands of fiber. She speaks with Charles Oswalt, the man who was convicted and sentenced with the crime. He has done his time and is now out of prison, but he maintains that he still is, and always was, innocent. David Messmore, a former detective for the Mansfield Police Department in Ohio, appears on the show and discusses the case.

programme.desc: Евгения и ее друзья ищут пропавшего Карского. С помощью необычного яда отравлены главный врач и его жена. Кому и чем они могли помешать?

programme.title: Азия
programme.desc: После обретения Узбекистаном независимости доля мусульман в стране значительно выросла. Начиная с 1980-х здесь начались необратимые процессы возрождения ислама. В 1990-х религия широко распространилась, появились первые религиозные группы. После протестов в Андижане в 2005 году, во время которых, по неофициальным данным, расстреляли от 200 до 1500 человек, правительство Каримова обвинило в организации беспорядков мусульман. Начались судебные протесты по обвинениям в "исламском экстремизме". Религия стала для власти "угрозой конституционному строю страны". В Узбекистане ужесточились репрессии над мусульманами. Насиба Узакова пережила пытки в тюрьме за свои религиозные убеждения. Репрессии коснулись также всей ее семьи. В этом фильме мы рассказываем ее историю.

programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. programme.title: Разбитые сердца
programme.desc: Люба никогда и ни в чем не нуждалась. Она выросла в обеспеченной семье, у нее прекрасные родители, любимый муж Леонид и маленькая дочка. Но неожиданно умирает отец и перед смертью открывает Любе тайну: у него есть внебрачная дочь, которую он бросил 20 лет назад. Чтобы искупить вину, он берет с Любы обещание разыскать сестру. Люба начинает поиски девушки. Однако вскоре она узнает, что у ее сестры Вики тяжелая судьба: ребенком она потеряла мать, выросла в детском доме, воровала еду, чтобы выжить, и даже побывала в колонии. Люба решает помочь сестре, знакомит ее с семьей, устраивает на работу. И именно с этого момента все в жизни Любы начинает рушиться…

programme.title: Азия
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Дочь за отца
programme.desc: Счастливая жизнь Веры заканчивается в один день. Она узнаёт, что её отец сядет в тюрьму по ложному обвинению в коррупции и убийстве. Вера намерена выяснить правду, найти настоящих виновных в преступлениях и вытащить отца из тюрьмы. Она устраивается работать в компанию, руководитель которой и подставил её отца, но неожиданно для себя влюбляется в своего главного врага...

programme.title: Экстрасенсы ведут расследование
programme.desc: В этой серии сильнейшим экстрасенсам предстоит расследовать два загадочных и пугающих дела. В каждом из них родители по необъяснимым причинам потеряли своих детей. В одном случае есть шанс найти пропавшую дочь, в другом - уберечь уцелевших деток от рока судьбы.

programme.title: Уловки разума
programme.desc: Опытный сотрудник Следственного комитета Кира Карелина привыкла работать с загадочными убийствами и владеет уникальной интуицией. Каждое дело она ведёт до логического конца. Однако есть одно, которое до сих пор не даёт ей покоя - дело об убийстве её матери. Константин Холмогоров, с которым она познакомилась при не очень приятных для него обстоятельствах, очень хочет помочь Кире. Он - профессиональный психотерапевт и исследует мотивацию преступников, чтобы предсказать их действия. В тандеме они слажено расследуют преступления и пытаются проникнуть в уголки памяти Киры, чтобы вернуть ей покой.

programme.title: Охотники за бриллиантами
programme.desc: В Одессе Беса ждeт любимая женщина Тася Коврова. Бес уговаривает еe уехать за границу. Чтобы выручить деньги на побег, он приходит к антиквару-оценщику Штерну и просит продать "Лилию". Одесские воры вызывают Беса на сходку в бане и требуют отдать в общак долю с награбленного у Толстой. Шахов организует у бани засаду, но Бесу удается уйти. Шахов хватает его на причале. Беса под конвоем отправляют в Москву, а найденную у него брошь торжественно возвращают Толстой.

Вера намерена выяснить правду, найти настоящих виновных в преступлениях и вытащить отца из тюрьмы. Она устраивается работать в компанию, руководитель которой и подставил её отца, но неожиданно для себя влюбляется в своего главного врага...

programme.title: Азия
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: С чистого листа
programme.desc: Даша Ермакова накануне свадьбы расстаётся с женихом и переезжает в Москву, чтобы начать жизнь с чистого листа. Не найдя достойную работу и жильё, она соглашается на подработку у известного психотерапевта Михаила Литовченко. Вскоре она подвергается нападению, получает сильное сотрясение мозга и теряет память. А когда приходит в себя, ей говорят, что она — Ирина Литовченко, жена Михаила. Даше предстоит разобраться, кто она на самом деле, вспомнить свою любовь, которую она встретила незадолго до трагических событий, а еще выяснить, куда и почему пропала настоящая Ирина Литовченко.

programme.title: Экстрасенсы ведут расследование
programme.desc: Лучшие участники шоу "Битва экстрасенсов" ищут пропавших без вести, расследуют загадочные убийства и выясняют истинные мотивы преступлений. Когда полиция бессильна, родственники жертв в отчаянии, а самые опытные следователи заходят в тупик, за дело берутся люди, чьи сверхспособности позволяют пролить свет на тайны прошлого, настоящего и будущего.

programme.title: Уловки разума
programme.desc: Следователь по особо важным делам Кира Карелина, чье невероятное чутье помогло разгадать множество преступлений, начинает ощущать на себе давление всевозможных версий и гипотез. Маньяк? Серийный убийца? Или что-то еще, более темное и загадочное? В то время как Кира погружается в пучину запутанных улик и непонятных свидетельских показаний, в городе появляется некий Константин Холмогоров, психотерапевт из Москвы, известный своими необычными методами и странными способностями. Его подход к проблемам уникален: он использует регрессивный гипноз, чтобы проникнуть в самые глубины человеческого разума и извлечь там скрытую правду.

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Охотники за бриллиантами
programme.desc: В ноябре 1980-го происходит ограбление вдовы А.Толстого. Из квартиры выносят антиквариат, но, главное, пропадает необыкновенной красоты брошь Королевская Лилия, изготовленная для Людовика XV. Поскольку вдова Толстого имеет обширные связи и в СССР и за рубежом, дело получает широкий резонанс, к расследованию привлекаются самые серьезные силы МВД, за ходом следствия следит лично министр МВД Щелоков. Следствие выходит на участницу ограбления - жену французского дипломата, которая собирается покинуть страну. Задержан и её сообщник, известный одесский вор по кличке Бес. Однако бриллиантов при них не обнаружено...

programme.title: Первый класс
programme.desc: Три подруги, трое шестилетних детей. И всего одно место в лучшей школе Петербурга. Бедная, но умная и высокомерная разведенка Таня, карьеристка и жена майора полиции Аня и красавица-жена бизнесмена Лена — ради любимого ребенка каждая из них готова рискнуть отношениями, дружбой и даже собственным достоинством.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Анатомия убийства
programme.desc: Евгения и ее друзья ищут пропавшего Карского. Поиски приводят Евгению в элитный пансионат "Винтаж", где проживала родная тетя Карского Полина Ивановна Мещерякова, о которой героям даже не было известно. Однако Евгения даже не успевает познакомиться с пожилой дамой - за минуту до их встречи тетю Карского обнаруживают мертвой. Окружающим эта смерть кажется естественной, но Евгения уверена - это убийство, и оно напрямую связано с исчезновением Сергея. А вскоре в пансионате "Винтаж" происходит еще одно преступление. С помощью необычного яда отравлены главный врач и его жена. Кому и чем они могли помешать?

programme.desc: Katrā šīs interaktīvās pirmsskolas komēdijas sērijā Dilans izmēģina jaunu profesiju un aicina savus draugus Oziju, Deiziju, Bitsiju un skatītājus mājās piedalīties spēlē. programme.title: Gabijas leļļu namiņš
programme.desc: Ar nelielu maģiju un ikdienas Leļļu mājas piegādi izpētiet fantastisko Leļļu māju ar Gabiju un visiem viņas kaķu draugiem. Gabija ir pozitīva un apņēmīga 11 gadus veca meitene, kura pieņem trūkumus un pārvērš kļūdas izaugsmē. Viņas labākais draugs Pandijs Ķepa vienmēr ir viņai blakus un ir gatavs jebkādam piedzīvojumam ar kādu kārumu un smaidu. Pievienojieties viņiem un pārējiem Gabijas kaķiem jautros piedzīvojumos! programme.title: Robopolicists Pollijs
programme.desc: Brūmstaunā, mazpilsētā ar varenu glābšanas komandu, allaž notiek negadījumi un nepatikšanas, piemēram, mašīna lietū noslīd no klints, kāda cita avarē, bērns tiek ieslēgts ugunsdzēsēju depo utt. Katrā sērijā glābšanas komanda kādu glābj.

programme.title: Gabijas leļļu namiņš
programme.desc: Ar nelielu maģiju un ikdienas Leļļu mājas piegādi izpētiet fantastisko Leļļu māju ar Gabiju un visiem viņas kaķu draugiem. Gabija ir pozitīva un apņēmīga 11 gadus veca meitene, kura pieņem trūkumus un pārvērš kļūdas izaugsmē. Viņas labākais draugs Pandijs Ķepa vienmēr ir viņai blakus un ir gatavs jebkādam piedzīvojumam ar kādu kārumu un smaidu. Pievienojieties viņiem un pārējiem Gabijas kaķiem jautros piedzīvojumos! Rotaļājaties, veicat rokdarbus, dejojiet un katru dienu atklājiet jaunas lietas!

Lokomotīvēm ik dienu jāpaveic kāds darbiņš – jāpārvadā cilvēki, jāpārvieto palaidnīgie vagoni, jādodas palīgā aizstāt citas lokomotīves, kamēr tās remontā. Katras dienas beigās neizbēgami tiek iegūta kāda vērtīga atziņa par dzīvi.

programme.title: Dilana rotaļu piedzīvojumi
programme.desc: Katrā šīs interaktīvās pirmsskolas komēdijas sērijā Dilans izmēģina jaunu profesiju un aicina savus draugus Oziju, Deiziju, Bitsiju un skatītājus mājās piedalīties spēlē. Ar bagātīgas iztēles palīdzību Dilans spēj pārvērst pļavu par jebko no viesnīcas līdz kosmosa stacijai. Kurš vēlas spēlēties?

programme.title: Leo pasaule
programme.desc: Leo pasaule ir godalgots itāļu multfilmu seriāls, kas galvenokārt paredzēts bērniem ar autisma spektra traucējumiem, taču vienlaikus piemērots visiem pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem. Māksliniecisks iestudējums, kas īpaši izstrādāts, lai aktīvi un tiešā veidā sazinātos ar tiem, kam ir grūtības koncentrēties un mācīties, lai nojauktu arvien plašākas invaliditātes barjeras. Pasaules Autisma izpratnes diena ir 2.aprīlī.

programme.title: Gabijas leļļu namiņš
programme.desc: Ar nelielu maģiju un ikdienas Leļļu mājas piegādi izpētiet fantastisko Leļļu māju ar Gabiju un visiem viņas kaķu draugiem. Gabija ir pozitīva un apņēmīga 11 gadus veca meitene, kura pieņem trūkumus un pārvērš kļūdas izaugsmē. Viņas labākais draugs Pandijs Ķepa vienmēr ir viņai blakus un ir gatavs jebkādam piedzīvojumam ar kādu kārumu un smaidu. Pievienojieties viņiem un pārējiem Gabijas kaķiem jautros piedzīvojumos! Rotaļājaties, veicat rokdarbus, dejojiet un katru dienu atklājiet jaunas lietas!
